The car isn\'t home? Finish now. The bridge keeps the car\'s Wi-Fi saved and connects by itself when the car is back — you\'ll get a notification then. Registering takes a minute in the car.
You use a bridge, so you can skip this: the app reaches the car through the bridge. It only helps when the car is away from home and the app connects to the car\'s Wi-Fi directly.
Only for connecting straight to the car (no bridge). Pair once, with the car nearby, so Android stops asking “Connect to device?” and the widget, tile and departures work in the background.

How to update it (needs a computer)

Log in to the bridge with ssh and run:\ncurl -sL https://github.com/Anwo91/phev-remote-plus/releases/latest/download/phev-bridge-pi.tar.gz | tar xz && sudo phev-bridge/install.sh phev-bridge/phev-bridge.jar\nThen search again.

Let the car remember the bridge
The car only talks to devices it has registered — at most two. Register the bridge once:

1. Sit in the car with the key and close the driver's door. Power switch OFF.
2. Press the power switch once to ACC, without touching the brake.
3. Within 10 seconds, press LOCK and UNLOCK on the key alternately — 10 presses in total, starting with LOCK.
4. Listen to the beeps.
How many times did the car beep?
None
The car didn\'t go into registration mode. Start again from power OFF: one press to ACC, then the 10 LOCK/UNLOCK presses within 10 seconds.

Three beeps: the car already remembers two devices, so there\'s no room for the bridge. To make room, every registered device has to be deleted — your phone too. Afterwards, register the bridge here and your phone again in Settings.
Start again
The car is now listening for 10 minutes. Tap the button.
Register the bridge
Registering… this can take up to a minute.
Registered! Now switch the car\'s power OFF.
The power is off
The car didn\'t accept the registration.
The car keeps listening for 10 minutes — try again. If it has been longer, start again.
Checking
Waiting for the bridge to reach your car… the car restarts its Wi-Fi after registering, which takes about a minute.
All set! The bridge reaches your car (battery %1$s%%).
At home, the app now talks to the car through the bridge — no need to be next to the car.
